eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 10:55 PM on AUG 12, 2022 Effective until 8:55 AM AUG 13, 2022. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Phoenix Police Department is looking for 64 year-old Virginia Abigail Walker. Virginia is 5 feet 6 inches tall and weights 135 pounds. She has blue eyes and blonde hair. Virginia was last seen on 08/12/2022 in the area of North 40th Avenue and West Camelback Road. Virginia suffers from a medical condition which may cause her to appear confused. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
